threads.body: The test that validated event name capture from a single-field Logstash marker (`Markers.append("otel.event.name", ...)`) was removed, leaving only the map-entries marker path covered. Since the README still documents `otel.event.name` support in “Logstash markers” broadly, it would be safer to keep an explicit test for the single-field marker form (or narrow the documentation if only specific marker types are supported).
